title: Microstructure and mechanical properties of RexNbMoTaW high-entropy alloys prepared by arc melting using metal powders
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting the mixture of pure metallic powders under a protective argon atmosphere, flipped and remelted five times on a water-cooled copper plate.
